title: connect_ws scheme validation before network I/O: SSRF prevention from compromised session document
description: connect_ws checks that ws_url starts with ws:// or wss:// before calling into_client_request() or any network code. A compromised or MITM'd session document could supply http:// or file:// as the WebSocket URL; tungstenite would attempt to connect to it, leaking credentials or hitting internal services. The check is a single line but is the only barrier between a tampered session document and SSRF. A contributor might argue it is redundant with tungstenite's own URL validation. It is not: tungstenite's error for a non-ws URL is a generic WebSocket error with no semantic distinction from a network failure; the explicit check makes the rejection clear and occurs before any I/O.
